from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyProfit(BaseModel):
    """The net profit attributable to shareholders reported in one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as written in the document")
    security_code: str | None = Field(description="The securities/trading code if mentioned")
    profit_amount: float | None = Field(description="The reported profit amount, signed (losses are negative)")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The unit of the amount: '元', '百万元', '千万元', etc.")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered by this figure")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Brief excerpt anchoring where this figure appears")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_profits: list[CompanyProfit]
